The regex `(\\*)(\[[a-z#/@][^[]*?])` only matches backslashes that are followed by a tag.
Backslashes that are NOT followed by a tag are NOT escaped.
This means a trailing backslash is never escaped.

If the goal of `escape()` is to make the string safe to be used as markup, then any backslash that could potentially escape a following tag should be escaped.
A trailing backslash could escape a tag if another string is appended to it.
But `escape()` is usually called on the whole string that will be inserted.
